provenance.origin: Fixed RGB probes sampled from PNGs rendered by the author's original WebGL shader in Chromium/SwiftShader, independently of the Flutter renderer. Native images were not used to choose expected RGB values.
provenance.oracle_renderer: Chromium headless with ANGLE SwiftShader; 720x540 canvas, deviceScaleFactor1. Original shader receives measured model snapshots.
provenance.random_initialization: 32-bit LCG, multiplier1664525, increment1013904223; unsigned output divided by2^32.
provenance.initial_frame: Frame0 at time0, dt0. Later frames advance dt1/60 before capture.
provenance.sampling: Single fixed framebuffer pixel per probe. Positions are defined from scene geometry and light-strip distance, with glass-interior probes kept away from glyph cells. Expected RGB comes exclusively from original-render-*.png.
provenance.scope: Independent regression of background, recess, glass bevel, LED position/tint/falloff and shadow across interrupted motion. This does not establish pixel-identical replay of the user recording or recover its unknown particle seed.
